title: Swim with Rosa
kaylee: She holds Rosa the pink dolphin and swims her through the flooded forest: hello to the capybaras, a splash for the sleepy sloth, leaps for the monkeys' fruit, a race with the otters to the rainbow. Every picture is drawn by hand.
questions: Is this the look you wanted for the level?
The otters say "So close! Again?" when they win: kind, or teasing?
Rosa says "Oopsie! Bonk!" when she bumps a log: funny, or too babyish?

links.label: Tune how the swim and the leap feel
